title: Instant Pot Chicken Cacciatore

items.n: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (4 thighs, about 170 g each)

steps.x: Rinse the thighs and pat completely dry with paper towels. Dry skin browns properly.
Heat the oil in the Instant Pot on Sauté. Add the thighs skin-side down and cook until browned, 6 min per side. Move to a plate and keep the drippings in the pot.
Add the mushrooms, celery and onion to the drippings. Cook and stir until soft, 5 min. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, 2 min.
Return the chicken to the pot. Add the tomatoes and tomato paste, sprinkle over the herbes de Provence, then pour in the water and add the crumbled bouillon.
Lock the lid, seal the vent and cook on High Pressure for 11 min. Pressure takes 10 to 15 min to build first.
Quick release, about 5 min. Open the lid away from you.
Check the chicken is 74°C at the thickest part near the bone. Stir in the black pepper, and add the red pepper flakes only to the adults' portions.
For a thicker sauce, remove the chicken, set the pot to Sauté and boil the sauce until reduced and thickened, about 5 min.

notes: Serve over spaghetti, rice or as a stew.
Fridge: 3 days in airtight containers. Reheat in the microwave until steaming hot.
Freezer: portion with sauce, up to 2 months. Thaw overnight in the fridge.
Tomatoes are a bit sour: stir in 0.5 tsp sugar at the end if needed.
Bouillon is salty. Taste before adding any extra salt.
Chilli is only a pinch. Add it to adults' portions after plating the child's.
